delta: # Story 12 — Desk shell: one

navigation, header and theme around every authenticated screen (Story: CRM-27)

## Prerequisites

- `PLATFORM-10-WEB` completed — the primitives in
`web/src/shared/ui/` and the tokens file at `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css` are in place, and the colour-literal guard `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.test

.ts` already scans the whole of `web/src`.
- Coordinate on **naming only** with `LANGUAGES-2-WEB (CRM-37)`: this

story must **not** add a language switcher; it only makes sure the shell does not stand in the way of one.
- Coordinate on **naming

only** with `PLATFORM-16-WEB (CRM-31)`: empty / loading / error state design lives there; the shell provides the frame, not the frame's contents.
-
Read `.squad/plan-lessons.md` before starting — the L-6, L-13 and L-16 rules are

the failure modes this plan is written against.

---

## Story Goal

Give every authenticated screen one shell: a single frame that renders nav

igation, a header and the theme root, so no future desk page re-implements them. Concretely:

1. Authenticated routes render **

inside** a `DeskShell` component; sign-in does not.
2. A `ThemeProvider` reads the visit
or's chosen theme (`light` | `dark`) synchronously from `localStorage`, sets `data-theme` on `<html>`, and exposes a control the shell ren

ders in its header. Reloading the page keeps the choice.
3. The shell adds **no direction logic** — the existing `I18nProvider` in `
web/src/shared/i18n/index.tsx:30–37` owns `dir` and `lang` on `<html>`, and every shell stylesheet uses CSS log

ical properties.
4. The shell's stylesheet contains **no colour literal**: dark mode is a second block of the same custom properties inside `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css`,

selected by `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. Rule **D-1** stays enforced by `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts`.
5. The hardcoded-strings guard (`web/src

/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts:30`) is extended to cover the shell's directory so no shell label can ship as a bare English literal.

Out of scope:
language switcher (CRM-37), empty/loading/error states (CRM-31), locale-formatted dates and numbers (CRM-39), session expiry (CRM-46), structure

-rule checker (CRM-30), any real desk screen (queue, customers, tickets), and any `api/` or `android/` change or new dependency.

---

## Context — Read These

Files First

1. `web/src/app/App.tsx` — the provider order today: `BrowserRouter` → `I18nProvider` → `AuthProvider` → `AppRoutes`. The new `ThemeProvider` must sl
ot between `I18nProvider` and `AuthProvider` so it wraps everything (sign-in included, so the theme itself never flashes)

but consumers can still `useTheme()` above and below the auth boundary.
2. `web/src/app/routes.
tsx` — three routes: `/sign-in` (bare `<SignInPage />`), `/` (`<RequireAuth><HomePage/></RequireAuth>`), `*` → `
<Navigate to="/" />`. The shell wraps the **authenticated** branch only: `<RequireAuth><DeskShell><HomePage/></DeskShell></RequireAuth>`.

`SignInPage` stays unwrapped — it has nothing to navigate to and nobody to greet.
3. `web/src/app/auth-context.tsx` l
ines 20–48 — the persistence pattern to copy: synchronous read in `useState`'s initialiser, `try/catch` around every `localStorage` read and write. Also l
ines 65 and 68–72 for provider / hook shape, and line 74 for the `AUTH_T

OKEN_KEY` export pattern.
4. `web/src/app/require-auth.tsx` — the auth boundary; do not change it. The shell must s

5. `web/src/shared/i18n/index.tsx` lines 8

Also confirms `language` is a **prop with a default of `'en'`** and nothing changes it today — the language switcher is CRM-37.
6

with the same property names, different values. Also lines 50–72: layout uses logical properties and never a `[dir="rtl"]` override.
7. `web/
src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts` lines 22–23 and 33–48 — the colour-literal guard. It walks the whole `WEB_SRC` tree, so any new shell CSS added an
ywhere in `web/src` is already covered. **No changes needed here.** Also lines 55–61:

8. `web/src
/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` lines 29–30 and 96–107 — `SCANNED = ['pages', 'features']`. This is the L-6 hole the intake

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Storage throws (private window, blocked site data).** `readStoredTheme` in
`web/src/app/theme-context.tsx` (task 2) returns `'light'`; `setTheme` swallows the write error so state still updates for

the current tab. Same pattern as `auth-context.tsx:24–28, 37–41, 46–50`.
- **Unknown stored value** (`local
Storage[THEME_KEY] === 'sepia'`). Guarded by the `THEMES.includes(raw)` check; anything else falls back to `'light'`. Prevents `data

-theme="sepia"` from silently disabling the palette.
- **First paint on `/sign-in` before authentication.** `ThemeProvider` sits above `App

Routes`, so `data-theme` is on `<html>` before either sign-in or the shell renders. No unthemed flash.
- **Unauthenticated visitor hits `/`.** `Require
Auth` (`web/src/app/require-auth.tsx:12–14`) redirects to `/sign-in` **before** `DeskShell` mounts; a nav bar never renders without an auth

enticated session.
- **Arabic (RTL) with the shell mounted.** The shell adds no direction logic. `I18nProvider` (`web/src/shared/i18n/index.tsx
:30–37`) sets `dir="rtl"` on `<html>`; the shell's stylesheet uses `padding-inline`, `border-inline-end`, etc., so navigation mirrors without a
second copy. Verified by extending `routing.test.tsx` (see Test Plan) to render the shell in `ar` and assert the

sign-out button still finds its accessible name.
- **A shell label added as a bare English literal.** Rejected by `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`
after task 5's `SCANNED` extension. Proof of coverage is required (L-16) and stated in the Verification Steps below

.
- **A shell stylesheet gains a colour literal.** Rejected by `tokens.test.ts:33–48`, which already walks the

whole of `web/src`. No change needed to that guard.

M-37. The shell must import nothing that mutates `I18nProvider`'s `language` prop.
